verdict_reason: Switching result headings to 'Name (code)' is correct and tested and matches the prototype's format, but the called namedLegendFor mispredicts by returning the bare code when no name exists.

todos.issue: labels.js:3,6 now calls namedLegendFor (commodity-legend.js:5-8), whose value word promises a named legend but which returns the bare code when the catalogue has no name (commodity-legend.js:7 falls back to legendFor, i.e. the code; labels.test.js asserts legendHtmlFor('01061900','') is '01061900'). Same shape as the house rule's countryNameOf example. The 'named' qualifier also implies legendFor is the un-named variant, so the feature now has two legend names for one commodity heading.
todos.fix: Must: the function labels.js calls has a name whose value word covers both values it returns (name with code in brackets, or the code alone). One way: rename namedLegendFor to something like commodityHeadingFor / legendLabelFor (the label shown: name and code, else the code) and update the import and call here.
